about.title: Founded in 2019 with a simple mission: honest fencing.
text: Ark Fence Company was founded in 2019 to bring honest, high-quality fencing to North Houston homeowners and businesses.
We are a faith-based, family-owned company, and we believe in doing the job right the first time and treating every customer the way we would want to be treated.
From our home base in Magnolia we have grown by word of mouth, and we leave your yard spotless with full cleanup and haul-away on every project.
